name: Yagyin's Digest
summary: Yagyin’s Digest is a book you carry back to Theldurin in the Badlands. He believes its truths may help save those threatened by what lies beneath the earth.

sections.title: A Dangerous Book
sections.body: Gerrig Bonegrip hands over Yagyin’s Digest for you to take to Theldurin. Gerrig warns that its truths can burn and asks you to keep it from unfriendly hands. The book matters to those who fear what may rise from below.

faq.answer: Yagyin’s Digest is a book Gerrig Bonegrip entrusts to you for Theldurin. Gerrig says it holds many truths and warns that the truth can burn.

aliases: who do I bring it to
faq.answer: Theldurin the Lost is the dwarf in the Badlands who sends you after Yagyin’s Digest and waits for you to bring it back.
Gerrig Bonegrip warns that the truths in Yagyin’s Digest can burn. He does not want it to reach unfriendly hands.

faq.q: What might the book help prevent?
faq.answer: Theldurin hopes your efforts may help save those threatened if the beings below are freed and rise to the surface.
